generationInputs.prompt:
Here, a hand is simulated quickly placing the cards in their positions, giving a more personal and manual feel.

Script/Visual Actions (with Spanish card meanings):

Second 0-1: View of a hand shuffling or choosing a card. Overlay title: "Discover Your Love"
Second 1-2: The hand places Card 1 in the center.
Second 2-3: The hand places Card 2 crossing the first.
Second 3-4: The hand places Card 3 on the left and Card 5 on the right, almost simultaneously.
Second 4-5: The hand places Card 4 at the top and Card 6 at the bottom, fluidly.
Second 5-7: The hand quickly places Cards 7, 8, 9, and 10 in the side column.
Second 7-8: Final shot of the complete spread. Text: "Tirada del Amor: Resuelve tus dudas." or "¿Tu lectura personalizada?"
Practical Tips:

Record hands close-up for clear details.
Speed up the video in editing to fit within 8 seconds.
You can overlay brief text on each card appearance, as in Option 1, to reinforce the meaning of each position.
Ensure good lighting so the cards are clearly visible
